description: Indulge in the iconic New York Baked Cheesecake, a quintessential American dessert renowned for its rich, dense, and incredibly creamy texture. This classic recipe delivers a perfectly golden top and a delightful graham cracker crust, making every bite a luxurious experience. It's a dessert that embodies simplicity and sophistication, perfect for any special occasion or a comforting treat.

instructions.title: Prepare the Crust
instructions.text: Combine the crushed graham crackers, melted unsalted butter, and 1/4 cup granulated sugar in a medium bowl. Press the mixture firmly and evenly into the bottom of a 9-inch springform pan. Bake in a preheated oven at 325°F (160°C) for 10 minutes, then remove and let cool completely on a wire rack.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Base
instructions.text: In a large mixing bowl, using an electric mixer, beat the softened cream cheese with 1 1/2 cups granulated sugar on medium speed until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy. Make sure to scrape down the sides of the bowl frequently to ensure no lumps remain.

instructions.title: Incorporate Dairy and Flavor
instructions.text: Add the all-purpose flour, full-fat sour cream, heavy cream, and vanilla extract to the cream cheese mixture. Beat on low speed until just combined. Be careful not to overmix at this stage; mixing too much can incorporate excess air, leading to cracks.

instructions.title: Add Eggs Gradually
instructions.text: Crack the large eggs into a separate bowl and lightly whisk them. Gradually add the whisked eggs to the cheesecake batter, beating on the lowest speed possible until they are just incorporated. Stop mixing as soon as no streaks of egg are visible to prevent overmixing.

instructions.title: Bake the Cheesecake
instructions.text: Pour the smooth cheesecake batter over the cooled graham cracker crust in the springform pan. Place the springform pan on a baking sheet to catch any potential drips. Bake in a preheated oven at 325°F (160°C) for 1 hour 15 minutes, or until the edges are set and the center still has a slight jiggle.

instructions.title: Cool and Chill Thoroughly
instructions.text: Turn off the oven, prop the door open slightly with a wooden spoon, and allow the cheesecake to cool inside the oven for 1 hour. This gradual cooling helps prevent cracks. Remove from the oven and cool completely on a wire rack at room temperature. Once cooled, cover the cheesecake and chill in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours, or preferably overnight, before serving for the best texture.

tips: For that signature dense and creamy texture, ensure all your dairy ingredients, especially the cream cheese and eggs, are at room temperature before mixing. This prevents lumps and helps create a smooth batter.

To avoid cracks, do not overmix the batter, especially after adding the eggs. Overmixing incorporates too much air, which expands during baking and then collapses, causing cracks. A water bath can also help regulate temperature and prevent cracking.

Always allow your New York Baked Cheesecake to cool gradually first in the oven, then at room temperature, and finally in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours. This slow cooling process is crucial for preventing cracks and achieving the perfect set texture.
